title: WebServer and CORS
symptom: When trying to fetch data from xDrip's webServer interface from a browser (e.g., Cobi.bike devkit or Fitbit), the request is blocked due to CORS, preventing the data from being displayed.
cause: The webServer response lacked the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header, causing browsers to block cross-origin requests.
fix: Added 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' to the response header of the webServer. This was included in the May 18th Nightly build.
evidence_quote: Would it be possible to add "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *" to the header of the response from the server so that JS running on a browser would also be able to fetch the data?
